title: Base change for a composite of proper morphisms follows from base change for the two factors
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that base change for proper morphisms is stable under composition (statement lines 18476-18484). The proof (proof lines 18486-18516) reduces to an injective torsion sheaf I, uses that f_*I is again injective so that the hypothesis on g applies, and then degenerates the relative Leray spectral sequence for the base-changed composite, whose two families of inputs vanish by the two hypotheses. H2: one reduction plus one spectral-sequence degeneration, written out.
